quest.title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Finale
quest.description: Félix Yogue, someone from the Court of Fontaine, still seems to have things he wants to say...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Unknown Item #364504 x1

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Ah, bravo! All six Evermotion Mechanical Painting parts, now returned to us! Now then, all we need to do is to splice them together again...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Why, of course! All these six smaller parts can be reunited as one!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Together, they will form a gigantic and beauteous Evermotion Mechanical Painting.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Come, come, all we need to do now is to join them up!

choices.text: Don't we need to cast it or anything?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: No, no, not at all. My machine is not some hastily cobbled-together amalgam of scrap!

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Every part is wonderfully, intricately meshed together like a... like a... Um...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Eh, never mind. I've never been the best at analogies. I swear Xavier stole all the talent in rhetoric for himself.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Either way, give it a go. It'll be interesting, I guarantee it.

choices.text: Is there any other work that needs to be done?

talks.objective: Splice the Evermotion Mechanical Painting together

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Perfect! Why, it's lovely! Skilled in both mind and hand, you are, and more so than I could have expected, too!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Hah. I do recall that several ludicrous manuscripts from The Steambird described you as... as...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Heh... As a straight-shooting knight-errant who prefers to let their blade do the talking.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Ah, how ridiculous and foolish those reporters were! How much ado they made about so little! After all, who are you, if not a sharp, smart, humble... and well, straight-shooting knight-errant?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: When I get the time, they shall hear from me. Oh yes, they will!

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Ah, right. Please take this particular device. You can take it out for a little leisure, should you, well, be at leisure.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: As for me, I've got to start raising the Mora I'll need to travel to Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Give it a go yourself. It'll be interesting, I guarantee it.
